source_review: All three complete patches, complete native driver, native reserved-memory lookup and ACPI compatible matching, local Android DICE mapping/wipe consumer and x86 pvmfw description examined. SDK-specific producer/use unconfirmed; retain generic configured interface conservatively. No firmware, hypervisor or Android userspace modified. Existing native protections and checks retained; no newer LTS change to this file is reversed.
security: Firmware supplies the physical region and remains trusted. ACPI discovery expands firmware-description support, not unprivileged arbitrary-physical-memory selection. The misc device starts at 0600; shared writable mappings and later write upgrades are blocked, mappings are non-dumpable/non-inheritable, private mapping behavior is unchanged. The driver transports/wipes opaque DICE data and does not validate chains, establish protected execution, authenticate a VM, or guarantee SDK attestation. Actual wipe coherence, firmware reservation and runtime security have not been tested.
validation: Exact patch and baseline comparisons plus configured target checks. Compilation will be recorded separately; build 197 predates these executable changes. No runtime test or remote resource used.
